description: Measurement concepts allowed to have no value on a retained Pages default run, each with the reason. Everything not listed here must carry a value on at least one run of its implementation and mode. Provisional entries are expected to clear after the 2026-11-04 reruns and are removed once they do.

exceptions.reason: Amaru 10.11.20261029 exports header receipt in the global epoch and slot start in chain-relative time; the interval is not measurable on this release.
The Amaru nanoseconds-v3 patch set for 10.11.20261029 carries no header-validation tap; porting the 20260918 nanoseconds-v4 tap is a separate Rust job.
Stock cardano-node exposes no single authoritative epoch-transition interval; the patched run carries epoch_transition.
Stock cardano-node exposes no authoritative per-execution Plutus wall-clock interval; the patched run carries plutus_vm.
Stock cardano-node does not emit the audited internal BlockFetch handler-queue boundary; the patched run carries the queue residence bounds.
Stock cardano-node does not emit a continuous TxSubmission request-to-mempool residence interval; the patched run carries the residence bounds.

A collector bug, not the node: cardano-node 11.1.2 traces each mempool sync as enclosingTime {edge: Starting} then {edge: <seconds>}, and the stock collector read only a bare number. The retained 2026-11-04 traces hold the records; the fixed collector replayed over them gives 111 (stock) and 119 (patched) samples. Remove this entry once a rerun of the fixed collector is retained.

The 2026-11-04 patched rerun (200-block controlled sync on amaru 10.11.20261029) produced no BlockFetch queue residence events: requests were never queued behind one another at this load. Measured fact, not an assumption.

Not exercised at the node boundary: the double spend served over node-to-node TxSubmission (2026-11-04 reruns, probe serve_transaction) was taken by the relay (ids and body requested) but the relay trace records no mempool decision for it, so the counter is an evidenced zero of 40 offered; the double spend is refused at the consumer socket and counted in rejected_operations instead.
